feats.title: Pain Doesn't Hurt
feats.description: While you are bloodied, you gain a +2 feat bonus to saving throws against ongoing damage. Increase this bonus to +3 if you have the Human Perseverance feat. In addition, the first time you are bloodied in each encounter, you ignore all ongoing damage until the end of your next turn.

feats.title: Action Recovery
feats.description: When you spend an action point to take an extra action, you can immediately make a saving throw against each effect on you that a save can end.
